scope: Fixed ensemble and model-scale falsification comparison on public BUBR1 reference; includes previously observed checkpoint 1
score: masked log probability of alternate minus reference residue; natural log; lower means less sequence-compatible
source_reading: Main text pages 1325-1327 and Figure 3/legend; supplementary D882A conclusion reported in main text, supplement not independently reviewed

controls.endpoint: Reduced abundance and impaired segregation/checkpoint in the reported reconstitution assays
Reduced abundance and impaired segregation/checkpoint in the reported reconstitution assays
Reduced abundance and impaired segregation/checkpoint in the reported reconstitution assays
Retained function and abundance in the reported reconstitution assays; not a clinically benign label
Reduced abundance and thermal stability; contextual check only
Main-text-reported retained function; contextual check only
controls.source_panel: Main text referring to Figure S3C

candidate_source: Previously permitted ranked candidate protein substitution; constructed on public reference, not a subject sequence

gate.rule: D882N must score strictly higher than every primary_impaired control in every prespecified window; numerical repeat difference <= 0.000001
gate.candidate_inference: All prespecified candidates are diagnostic outputs, even for a failed control gate; never select only passing models for the ensemble. No clinical interpretation from failed qualification.
gate.no_reselection: Use all seven models and all three windows; no replacement or score-direction change after results. Checkpoint 1 results were already observed.
gate.interpretation: A conservative resource-allocation gate, not validated sensitivity/specificity or a pathogenicity threshold

limitations: Small selected control set from one study; one primary retained-function site; substitutions at shared sites are not independent
Engineered reconstitution in cancer cell backgrounds is not deficient non-cancer tissue or the selected pair
No tuning set, no fitted classifier and no clinical probability calibration; this is a fixed directional challenge
Protein evolution may reflect processes outside the reported assay; disagreement does not invalidate the experiment or universally invalidate ESM
Shared evolutionary information with prior predictors; no independent experimental replication
Stop-gain/NMD, phase, exposure and drug rescue are outside this model's inference
Checkpoints/windows/model scales are correlated sensitivity analyses, not independent biological replicates or confidence intervals
ESM2 general sequence model scores are exploratory; increased size does not establish validity
All models float32 with TF32 disabled. OOM is a technical failure, not a zero score; no hidden precision change.

structural_comparison.inputs: public UniProt WT and six published control substitutions plus permitted N1002K on residues 721-1044
structural_comparison.msa: empty single sequence, no MSA service; explicit performance limitation
metrics: local CA RMSD within 10 reference positions of each substitution
structural_comparison.interpretation: Structure resemblance or confidence is not folding stability, protein abundance, enzymatic activity or functional rescue. Compare all controls and all seeds, not best-ranked structures. Three seeds are sampling variability, not biological replicates.
structural_comparison.full_length: Defer until domain comparisons demonstrate an interpretable contribution; do not escalate merely to occupy GPUs.
